_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Closed-loop controller using VLC for commands and VLS (Backscattered Intensity from Retroreflective Foil) for rotational angle sensing.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: System setup (Coordinator + Worker). Fig 3: Timing diagram showing TDM (Sensing vs Illumination phases). Fig 5: Control loop step response (Angle vs Time).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: VLC-ISAC (VLC + VLS). Function: Remote control of a servomotor. Sensing: Rotational Angle via reflected intensity from a triangular foil (nLoS VLS). Comm: Frequency Modulated Light (500-700 Hz) sending commands.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Accuracy: 1.2 degree average deviation. Max error 5 degrees. Range 0-205 degrees.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Integration via Time Division Multiplexing (TDM) to avoid interference between Comm modulation and Sensing intensity measurement. Simple, low-cost implementation.

bibliographic.title: Integrated Sensing and Communication in the Visible Spectral Range: A Novel Closed Loop Controller
bibliographic.authors: Christian Fragner, Andreas P. Weiss, Franz P. Wenzl, Erich Leitgeb
bibliographic.venue: 2022 13th International Symposium on Communication Systems, Networks and Digital Signal Processing (CSNDSP)

application.scenario_description: Closed-loop feedback control of a servomotor's rotational position using VLC for commands and VLS for angle feedback.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First practical implementation of a visible light-based closed-loop controller using backscattered VLS for rotational angle sensing and VLC for command transmission, integrated via TDM.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of low-cost, low-complexity ISAC systems for industrial control loops that combine sensing and actuation/communication in the visible spectrum.

transmitter.notes: White LEDs. Cree MC-E (Sensing) and Circular LED Module (Comm).

integration.notes: TDM: Sensing Phase (Intensity measurement, no modulation) vs Illumination/Comm Phase (FM modulation).

waveform.notes: Comm: Frequency Modulation (500-700 Hz pulses). Sensing: CW/Unmodulated (Intensity measurement).

comm_metrics.notes: Low rate command transmission (stop, CW, CCW).

sensing_metrics.notes: Rotational Accuracy: 1.2 degrees (~0.02 rad). Range limited to 0-205 degrees.

tradeoff.notes: TDM approach separates functions to avoid trade-off/interference.
